reviews.text: Excelente servicio. Comida super rica el precio vale cada centavo. Un buen ambiente para ir con la familia.

I was introduced to Trippy Taco via a Yelp experience. Since I was happy with what I saw (or rather, with what I ate), I've dropped by Trippy Tacos on a few occasions to satisfy taco cravings. Overall, I cannot complain about the food, quality, service and price. Tacos will typically run $3-$4, which is a bit standard for the area, and they are loaded with plenty of fixings. Also, Trippy has daily specials for certain items on the menu. For small place, the restaurant has a pretty extensive Tex-Mex menu, so I think everyone should find something that they'll like. Although the restaurant has some seating, this place is more of a take-out spot. One tip: I highly recommend ordering before arriving to Trippy Taco, so you can simply grab and go. Unfortunately, parking is a bit limited and tight (like most places in this area). While the food, service and prices are pretty good, I'll admit that I would not go too far out of my way to visit since there are no shortage of Tex-Mex spots in the area. But, it's a great spot to check out on your way from Point A to Point B. Usually, I visit on my way home from the gym (to undo the benefits of my workout).

I am not an expert of Latin foods but this place make me feel mouth-watering. This is my first time here, I tried to order 3 flavors Tacos (Beef, Chicken, Pork) and Chicken empanadas. They were better than I expected. All looks very appetizing and smell so good. It seems really homemade style, fresh ingredients and aromatic. The chicken empanadas are surprisingly huge and you got 2 pieces for $11, that is reasonable, for me. As well as Tacos cost just about $3-4 each, it is a soft Taco with corn tortilla and flavorful seasoned filling, plus green salsa - that's perfect combination. I have not much to say about service, as it was a take out by online order but it was smoothly pick-up, everything was ready and packed nicely when I was arrived. The restaurant is quite tiny and old building at the back, but there are plenty free parking available around. Mainly for take out order but I think you can dine-in too - there are some seating table inside and outside. The Trippy Taco menu seem variety and interesting. They have not only Taco, but also a lot selection of Burrito, Soup, Quesadillas, Sandwich, Nacho and Fries. Yes, don't judge a book by its cover before you explore it.

Stopped by Trippy Tacos in Wheaton after a serious taco craving and it absolutely delivered. The lengua tacos were the standout. Tender, flavorful, and cooked exactly how they should be. The large taquitos were crispy on the outside and packed with filling, and the pupusas were comforting and satisfying. Everything tasted fresh and made with care, not rushed or generic. Really happy to see a solid local spot in the area putting out food like this. If you're in Wheaton and want bold flavors and a satisfying meal, Trippy Tacos is definitely worth the stop. I'll be back.

I first visited thanks to Yelp and made a return on my own. This time, I tried tacos and they were delicious! Filled with meat that wasn't dry, but well seasoned. The corn tortilla were not dry and didn't tear, just the right thickness. The person who helped me was friendly and service was quick. I'll definitely be returning and recommending this place.

I was first introduced to this business through Yelp a few years ago, and I've returned several times for official Yelp events and on my own. I'm just now writing a review! Better late than never. The service is always great! The food is very authentic and so delicious. This is where I got "put onto" pupusas! Today I stopped by for "Taco Tuesday." I got two chicken tacos ($2.50 each) and two steak tacos ($2.99 each). I didn't have to wait too long. The space inside isn't huge but there's a couple seats. In the warmer months, there's outside seating! Check out Trippy's if you haven't yet! You won't regret it!

Language barrier so they take in-store orders from a kiosk; TELL them your order is done and your number, make sure you see them take the ticket and put it up for the chef; because somehow my order got tossed on the floor and I guess they thought I was just standing there waiting for 40 MINUTES for my entertainment... mind you everything is made fresh including taco shells, so the 5 person order I placed was now going to take another 30 minutes for my food to be ready..... After being in that place for 70 minutes they wouldn't comp me or offer any solace other than an apology. This is clearly a good food truck turned storefront, with no front of house management or customer service skills (for non Spanish speakers). May visit again but first impression sucked.

Trippy came to our neighborhood for bi weekly food truck night. Staff were friendly and efficient. Food was good with tacos soft and warm. Tacos piled with steak and cilantro. The only criticism was it was fairly bland. No salsa or spice in the meat.

Forgot to picture the rest of my food but this food is just ok! The al pastor and carnitas were way more salty than I would've liked and could not really enjoy it because of that. The portions of the burrito and tacos were reasonable, but $12.49 for a burrito I would've enjoyed fresher ingredients. The hibiscus drink was refreshing. The service was nice and the employees were friendly.

This hidden taco spot is just what I needed on a Monday evening after work. The service was good, and our food came out quickly. It's a pretty small restaurant (clean) but I did sit down and eat the trippy nachos which were absolutely amazing! So fresh and loaded full of flavor! The guacamole was so good. I loved the nachos! Additionally, we tried the chicken and steak tacos which were delicious as well, and I loved the birria ramen. That was my favorite, so much flavored packed into that ramen. Definitely the best Birria ramen I've had to date and a must try!! I will most certainly be back because this food was so good. I'm a taco girl so I'm so happy I found another authentic taco place.

Tried to order a few items at their food truck at Doc Waters Ciderery on 11/2. Waited in line for an hour and a half to order only to be told that they only took VenMo and cash. The only problem is that signal was poor. Proceeded to wait another hour for the food only to be told after a third guy showed up to restock that they missed my order. Waited another thirty minutes and was then told they lost my order and myself and a few others had to re-order. At that point my wife and I asked to get refunded and at least there was enough cash to refund us. The food looked good but if the truck couldn't keep up they should've packed it up instead of having customers waste their time. The whole experience really put me off from trying their brick and mortar.

Pro: restaurant beeper. Con: price, food. Was at the June 29,2024 Gaithersburg summer fest and Trippy Tacos were one of many food vendors at the location. I ordered the chicken taco and the steak nachos. The tortilla of the taco didn't test fresh and the chicken was very bland. The nacho didn't have that much cheese, the chip was kind of soggy, and too many sauces on top. The only positive is that the taco truck has a beeper to let you know when to come pick up your food. All in all, I don't know if the quality of the food here in their food truck is different from the sit down restaurant but I know I won't be eating here again in the future. The only thing "trippy" about this establishment is the price of the foods and the subpar taste.

Had a bomb carnitas taco and revuelta pupusa from here last week. They were both great. The pupusa wasn't served with any sauces or veggies but it was fireeee. The carnitas were so delicious and flavorful. Also, THE PRICE IS RIGHT. I spent like $8 for both. The pupusa was big and filling AF. The employees working were very nice and attentive, too.

I had recently stopped by Trippy Tacos to grab a quick lunch, and it didn't disappoint! Their menu is pretty extensive, offering items such as tacos, burritos, quesadillas, tortas, birria, nachos, fries, pupusas, mulitas, and various sides, along with rotating/featured specials. I ordered a cheese pupusa and a medium-sized horchata (they also have a large size, too) - usually, I like my pupusas a bit more crispy and more on the 'greasier' end, but Trippy Tacos' version was pretty tasty - sure, it could have been crispier, but I felt like it was one of the 'healthier' versions of a pupusa; the filling, however, was generously stuffed with cheese, and while stuffing my face, I was trying to figure out how they were able to do this! The horchata was more on the thinner consistency, but it was still tasty and refreshing. Service here is super kind, friendly, and welcoming - the staff are very sweet! I really liked how small and intimate this place was - it was well-decorated, and there were a couple of tables and stools at the counter. Another plus was that there was a sink by the entrance where you can wash your hands before- and after your meal - so convenient! I'd love to check out their highly-rated nachos, the pupusa pizza, and their Taco Tuesday specials. Plenty of parking in the lot.

Great find! Not only good Mexican food but excellent Peruvian food as well. I got to interact with the two ladies in the kitchen, and they were kind and professional. I saw them cooking things from scratch, and you can taste it. The lomo saltado had lots of sauce, fresh veggies, and that char flavor you get from the flame when you stir fry. The ceviche was also of outstanding quality. We look forward to returning and trying more items. I'm hoping they have more agua fresca flavors if others taste like the horchata and tamarindo.. boy oh boy, I'm in trouble!

So glad i was able to try a new taco spot. I got the trippy fries and the birria ramen for my partner. He said he'd get the ramen again and that it reminded him of chili from Kentucky. There were lots of fries for $15. I'll try it again :).

This is the second time I'm ordering from this place because their Tacos are delicious! The pastor, carnitas and steak! Bought take out. The young lady who served me was very friendly and helpful. This is a small business owner, there's some seating inside if you so choose to eat in. Their nachos are also delicious! I will definitely return.

I wish this place was closer to me because I really loved their Lengua tacos! Lengua Tacos- 5 of 5.. I mean.. Lengua tacos are my all time favorite tacos. These meat pieces were bigger than what you would typically get at *generic taco shop* - and they were soo juicy. I ordered 2 tacos that came out to a little over $7, to me, that's definitely worth it. Al Pastor Tacos - 1 of 5 - I really did not enjoy this taco at all. And..that's all I'll say about that. Carne Asada con queso - 5 of 5- I have never had flour tortilla tacos served with cheese! I honestly was taken aback when they asked if I wanted this with cheese or not. Eaten fresh, it's super toasty with the cheese melting and oozing. Even when we let the taco sit there for awhile and cheese had hardened, it still tasted so good. Pupusas con frijoles y queso- 5 of 5 - The pupusas was nice and hot- The pupusa was over filled with beans (not that I'm complaining) - I wish the sauces given were spicy or had a kick (I love spicy). The pickled vegetables for the pupusas were fresh and tangy, paired very well with their pupusa. I did not get their frescas but they offered tamarind, horchata and one more flavor. They had a large variety of sodas in their cooler, including Pepsi Zero products. The person who helped us at the register was so friendly and helpful. He let us know about the Taco Tuesday deals and offered ice to us with our soda since it wasn't cold. The place was very small, like maybe it was a mom and pop shop. It was just the kitchen and then 1 small table for 2 and a bar along the window with some stools. The place did not have a public bathroom. There was no music playing when I went, so it was kind of nice just listening to the hustle and bustle of the stoves, and the chitter chatter of the guests. I hope to one day venture out to this part of MD again so that I could try the best nachos in MD and to get some more lengua tacos!

I loved the customer service. Julissa was super friendly and patient. We ordered a bunch of things: taco al pastor, tamal, mulita de asada, torta de asada, horchata, and the trippy fries. My favorite were the mulita and the torta. The tamal is peruvian style and it was really good too. The taco al pastor was good but it needed a little more flavor. The fries were gigantic! The horchata was delish too. My order was togo and everything was nicely packaged, we didn't have any spills! But we realized they forgot to give us the birria ramen that we wanted to try. They have started offering Peruvian food sandwiches we may go back to check that out soon. Definitely a come back spot!
Amazing nachos. Great service. Some of the best in the area. Good for kids and adults. Would recommend to anyone.

Absolutely loved the food here. I ordered 2 al pastor tacos and 1 chicken taco, which were delicious, fresh and juicy. Service was absolutely amazing. Ambiance was great and super chill. I really love the outside eating area. I definitely recommend this place and will be coming back again.

There's not a lack of taco spots in the D.C. area. Well I found one that has something I've never seen before. A pupusa PIZZA?? Ok...I was on the first flight out to Wheaton. Their Chicken Trippy Nachos ($14.50) - the chips were thin and fresh, and the sweet Trippy sauce gave these nachos a distinctively sweet and savory flavor. Their Birria Burrito ($13.50) - fresh, meaty, dipped in that consume...winning. Their Tacos - All tacos come on a corn tortilla with melted cheese, onions, cilantro, lime, hot and mild sauce. Chicken Taco ($3.49), Al Pastor Taco ($3.49), Steak Taco ($3.99) - all delicious, meaty but bland without the hot red and green sauce, but tasty with it. Their 16" Pupusa Pizza Revuelta ($27.99) - this pie was huge, flavorful, and dense with marinated pulled pork. The cabbage and sauce set this off. Customer Service: On Point. Online Navigation: Easy. Parking: Plentiful. Recommendations: Try the Pupusa pizza, Nachos, and Birria Burrito.

Tried Trippy Tacos months ago and didn't publish the review! My husband and I had the Chicken burrito and Sopa de Res (it contained yucca, carrot, corn, cabbage leaves, three pieces of beef ribs in assorted sizes, and lots of salty, delicious broth). I placed the order online and everything was ready to go. The staff packed all of the garnishes and were kind in the brief interaction I had. I loved the music playing in the restaurant. There isn't room to dine in, but very simple to park and carry-out.
Had to double back and get me some of their bomb chicken tacos! The service was good, they were warm and welcoming. And they had a nice intimate seating area that had cool decorations.

Nasty. Pretty much feel robbed. I'd relish the opportunity to have the owner try this food and tell me what they thought of the quality and taste. Waited 30 minutes for stale chips literally doused in sour cream and some weird pink sauce. Like 7,000 pickled jalapenos piled in the corner and maybe an 1/8th cup of very strange looking chicken. I've never ever ever just trashed food I've paid good money for. But I took 1 look at these nachos, tried 1 bite against my better judgement, and took the whole rest of the container out to dump. 0s, absolutely do not recommend. Ever. Trippy nachos... Like they're tripping thinking this is passable in exchange for my hard-earned money.

Delicious! Pricing is a bit steep but the quality is amazing, so it's worth every penny. The tortillas were a little thicker and tasted like happiness while the lengua had a perfect bite; chewy without being nauseating and seasoned well. The beef tasted good but needed the salsa (looooooved the green one) and the pupusa was larger than expected. Great flavor but the tacos made me happier. I loved the curtido and could probably eat an entire plate by myself. Would I order again? Absolutely. Should you put them on your bi-weekly rotation? Definitely.
Ordered 3 steak tacos and 3 chicken tacos from their food truck. The steak was very tough and difficult to chew, and the chicken lacked flavor, very bland.

The trippy tacos food truck was parked in front of the Starbucks in North Bethesda Market. I ended up ordering a chicken taco and an al pastor taco. Also a side of guacamole and a side of pico. Both of the tacos were VERY tasty. They are definitely more traditional style Mexican tacos that come with chopped onions and cilantro and come in 2 tortillas for each taco which are listed on the menu as handmade corn. The tortillas were quite delish. My bar is a bit high for tacos... which is why this rating is put against all the other tacos I've eaten. Were they the best tacos no... but they were certainly super good. They'd make it into the top 10. It took about ten minutes to get the tacos ready and when I grabbed my box and went to go sit at the outdoor tables to eat, I realized they had forgot my guacamole and gave me sour cream instead. Both the pico and guac were ON point. This is a guac that if you had a spoon, you'd just want to shovel it into your mouth. The pico was so good I want the recipe. Honestly, some of the best pico I've ever had. Definitely a food truck that is worth stopping by.
I've only tried the birrias so far but I love this place just off this one meal. I personally prefer the beef over the pork but both taste great. I've been 4-5 times in the last 3-4 months.

Absolutely loved it here! I've lived in this area almost my entire life and never ate at this shopping center even though I always passed by. The food was amazing!!! I ordered the chicken nachos, birria carne tacos and chicken tacos were also ordered. The tacos had their own unique flavor which made this place so memorable. My nachos were massive! I can't remember the last time a restaurant gave me so much food. It was so delicious, everyone enjoyed them. I want to go back and try their Pupusa Pizza. Customer service is great. Employees working were very kind and friendly. Not a lot of space if you decide to sit and eat. But overall, great experience. Parking available.

I stopped by to get a torta al Pastor. The meat was juicy and tasty and the bread was soft with a crunch inside from being toasted. The only thing was that the lettuce was too big for the buns, once I took a bite then the whole torta had opened up. The ladies who served me were attentive and polite. I also had the tamarindo juice. I felt it a bit bitter but tamarindos are like that, it can be a hit or miss between bittersweet.

Placed an order for pickup through the website, I got there early, but it was ready a couple minutes after I arrived which was great. This was my second time here and the employee was courteous and efficient. It's taco Tuesday so the tacos are slightly discounted, but I got chicken, steak, and carnitas tacos with cheese (50 cent up charge for the cheese). The chicken was nicely seasoned and not dry. Steak was fine, nothing to write home about but it was cooked well and again, was not dried out. Carnitas again it was good, no complaints. I had the Al pastor the last time I went and it was just meh. All in all, chicken has been my favorite, I'll try the others another day. Pretty bland review, so why is it 5 stars? Easy, the freshly made tortillas. I generally do not like most corn tortillas, they usually end up crumbly, I know it'll be at places that use packaged tortillas, but man the tortilla is so important. The ones they make here are probably double the thickness of most other places, but they still hold their shape and moisture, and such a good corn flavor. Oh yeah, their nachos are great. Big portion with lots of toppings so you shouldn't have a problem with dry tortillas at the bottom. Forgot to mention earlier that the protein portion is generous per taco. Going to try the Birria one day.

We've been to Trippy Tacos twice now and will definitely be back. Our first visit we ordered two chicken tacos and a quesadilla. Everything was delicious. The quesadilla was huge and we got two lunches out of it. But it was the tacos that really caught our attention. The tortillas were awesome and did not fall apart. They held up to the filling. Our second trip back we ordered two chicken tacos and two chicken tacos with cheese. I honestly didn't really notice the cheese so would probably just skip it next time. The restaurant seems geared more to carry out than eat-in. There is a counter with some stools but no tables or booths. It's clean and the staff are extremely pleasant and efficient. The restaurant is kind of tucked away next to Seafood in the Buff in what I believe used to be a pizza place. I'm really happy to have found Trippy Tacos and can't wait to go back. If I can resist those tacos I'd like to try some other menu items.

Small taco spot in silver spring - We came in on a weekday evening and they had a line inside. There is a small bar where a few people can sit to eat, but no tables so plan on take out most likely. They only had a couple of people working, and these ladies were working very hard to get everyone's order out. We had called ahead for an order of 3 chicken tacos, and they started making our order as soon as we got to the front of the line. These are not the best tacos I've had in this area, but they are also not the worst. Definitely towards the bottom though. The chicken, although it didn't look seasoned at all, had flavor. The salsas were very good and very hot. Altogether, I probably wouldn't return for the tacos, they do have a good menu, and the nachos looked pretty good when I saw them being prepared in the kitchen.

This place is definitely hidden -- shout out to my excellent search skills that helped me discover it! They have digital screens that show the menus, and their prices are awesome! They have a sign on the register that indicates them winning a local award for the BEST nachos -- their Trippy Nachos! They're known for their Trippy sauce, which is a house recipe that goes on their nachos and many other offerings. So, I decided I would try that and some of their tacos. I got my tray of Trippy Nachos... outstanding. Lots and lots of sauce, and very few chips were left dry! It was also just a ton of food period, so it was two portions for me. SO not to be greedy... I saved my chicken and al pastor tacos for the next day. They were DELICIOUS!! That's some great quality stuff. As such, I am quite pleased, and looking forward to returning!

Trippy tacos brought their truck to our private event - it was so easy to work with them from start to finish, planning to execution. Friendly, professional, delicious! Highly recommend for your next event!

The food here is a 10/10 and I can't wait to come back. I believe they are fairly new so please be kind and patient because they are making sure your food is made perfectly! I got the carnitas tacos and myyyyy goodness I'm not really a carnitas girl but they have officially changed that. The meat was bursting with flavor well seasoned the perfect tortillas coming from someone who hates corn tortillas these were good. I know they look like flour ones but they weren't. That tomatillo sauce was mwahhh chefs kiss I can't wait to come back and try other things.

Well, I liked this place so much, I came back again. Ordered a few things for lunch: al pastor and steak tacos, pork and cheese pupusa, and aqua fresca. Not sure what flavor the drink was but it was dark red and very good. Didn't taste like anything I've had before, and it was very refreshing. By the time I got home, the tacos kinda dried out, but the 2 sauces (green and orange) helped quite a bit. Pretty good amount of meat although no pineapple in the al pastor. The pupusa was good too; reheated that in air fryer to crisp it up some. Would definitely return soon to try a torta or quesadilla.

Food is good and affordable. Taco de lengua was yummy! Nice juicy chunk of meat! Tortilla was made fresh to order! I wish I ordered more! Cheese pupusa was ok. Revuelta pupusa needed some seasoning and salt. The cabbage that came with it was nicely marinated and tasted great with the pupusa. Everything was made fresh to order so call ahead to place your order to avoid long wait time! Overall, I will definitely come back for the lengua taco. Though, the cashier was not exactly friendly... she seemed very bothered and impatient when I asked questions about the revuelta pupusa... hopefully I'll catch her in a better mood in my next visit.

This review is for their brick and mortar location, as I haven't had a chance to experience their mobile taco truck. I came here with a friend after they showed me a TikTok video of this place. I've probably driven by a dozen times, but didn't actually notice where it was until I placed the address in my GPS. It's definitely one of those places that can be easily missed if you're not actively looking. On the plus side, they do have their own small parking lot in front which wasn't too crowded when I went. The interior is small. We decided to dine in because we ordered a bunch of things. There aren't many options in terms of seating other than the counter space at the front window with a couple of stools lining it. Everyone that came in while we were eating got their food to-go, so I'm assuming that's what most of their traffic does. As for the food, we tried the steak nachos, beef birria tacos, and some chicken tacos. The tacos were on point! They definitely didn't skimp on the meats and everything was full of flavor. My favorite out of everything I ordered were the birria tacos. They oozed with cheese and the corn tortilla was perfectly crispy. I wish the consomme that came with it was a little bigger, but it was still very flavorful. The nachos were alright, my only gripe about it was that the jalapenos tasted pickled/from a can, which was a slight turn off. However, even with that being said, they were still sizable and definitely enough to share with others. Overall, I'd come back to get more tacos. For me, it was worth the trek there.

Chris Robles has brought his Food Truck to my fall party for all our employees for the past 4 years. Everyone loves walking up to the window and ordering exactly what they want. Many come back for seconds! The food is piping hot and delicious, with homemade sauces and pico to go with everything. The addition of beepers after ordering was great! Everyone knew exactly when their order was ready. I love him because he is entirely dependable, adds new menu items each year and takes the mess and leftovers with him. I heartily endorse his food truck for your next party!
Food was very good, very affordable, we will definitely return asap... really enjoyed the guacamole, did not skimp on ingredient! The opposite! Don't miss it!

For whatever reason I opted to try this place instead of going to tacos don perez down the road like I usually do, and it was a huge mistake. The rice is wet and slimy, the tortillas were really thick and slightly raw inside while being burnt on the outside. Of the tacos I got, the Al pastor and chicken were both dry and flavorless, and the Al pastor was also chewy. The carnitas taco was the only thing I was able to finish.

I really enjoyed the food!! I like the fact that you can watch them make your order in the spot. It is a small place but hey, don't they say great things come in small packages? That's exactly what happens with this little place. Once I got inside I could see that they were very popular among the locals because there was a lot of traffic and I could tell from the conversations that customers were having with the employees they knew them. I like that! That's what food is all about! Bringing people together!

Trippy Tacos is awesome i had the Birria tacos, a steak taco, chicken Pupusas and Birria Ramen all were excellent choices. Their tacos taste really fresh and organic like you don't feel heavy after eating them so that a good and bad thing if you keep eating lol. Everything was well made and fresh. Give them a try if you want some good tacos! Also service was outstanding and the place has really a really good vibe.
I love their tacos and pupusas. They delivered food for my birthday and everyone loved the food. We thought we ordered too much but everything was eaten fast.

Delicious homemade corn tacos and pupusas. So excited that I will soon live near this place. There's a couple of tables outside and a row of indoor seating, or you can get it to go. Cheap and delicious.

After advising friends about sub par food and service, some friends went to this place to get food. Not only were the tacos cold but the friend who did eat got sick that same night. The food is still terrible, the service is bad and the owners would like to take action. But never do. Save your money.

Got the chicken nachos for $14.50. The nachos were odd. There was thousand island dressing which was confusing. The guac was a little watery and had too much lime. Portions were huge which made for two meals but I've definitely had better nachos at Taco Bell.

I visited the other evening and it was a bit hard for me to find. Luckily there were a few flags that said TACOS and other items to let me know where to turn. Parking is available around the shopping center. The store has 2 tables with 2 chairs each, and a bar-like table area with more seats. So seating is limited. The staff were friendly and the food came out pretty quick! I got the al pastor mulita, a steak burrito, a horchata, and a tamarindo. I've never had a mulita before, and it's basically like a mini quesadilla. It was cheesy, gooey, and had the right amount of protein in it. I typically only get cheese quesadillas, but dang was this amazing with the al pastor. On top of that, the burrito was so good! I felt like the steak was cooked so well, that it basically melted in my mouth. The horchata is good and was nice to have as a refreshing drink along all the dairy. It was also my first time having a tamarindo, which tasted kind of like a tamarind lemonade. It wasn't for me, but maybe for someone else. I definitely need to come back to try other items when I'm in the area!

Service- walked in and looked like no one was working there. They have a screen for you to order your own food. Food was ehhh. They skimpy on meat. Got the Birria nachos. Lots of cheese and sour cream.. meat was good but a joke of amount. Torta was plain. Couldn't even taste any meat.

So I tried this place since it was next door to seafood in the Buff, and they did not disappoint. The food was awesome, and the staff could not have been more friendly. The manager Chris was bright and enthusiastic and told me the back-story on how they started in a food truck, just a few years ago, and due to the high quality of food, opened a store as well. Alexis was also amazing, she went above and beyond to ensure my visit was great. I would definitely recommend this place.

These Tacos were the best tacos I have ever had! The sauce made the tacos so much better. They had delicious cheese and the beef was so tender and flavorful. The service was so good our food came out so fast, I went here with my family and totally recommend it to anyone who wants delicious Tacos.

We engaged the Trippy Tacos truck and team to come to our house for a birthday party. These people are totally professional, as well as considerate and kind. Food was fresh and delicious. Tacos, quesadillas, etc. very fairly priced. Highly recommended!
Tacos and nachos were amazing! Definitely some of the best quick Mexican food I have had in a while.

The food was fresh and tasty and a bargain on Taco Tuesday. We had the chicken, veggie, and al pastor tacos ($2.50 each), each of which came with two separate sauces (one verde and one a spicy red). We also ordered the fries with the trippy sauce, which is basically a ketchup-mayonnaise combo. The meal is a great value for the quality. We ate inside, but most orders were pickup or to-go. We will definitely return since I want to try their nachos, which they say are the best in Montgomery County!
Steak and veggie tacos. Very good 10/10 recommend and will be returning. The shop is small so expect to take out.

Pains me to say it, but these tacos are just plain bad. The tortillas are thick and flavorless, and the fillings were completely lackluster. Was sad because we were excited to have a new taco spot nearby, but the food is just not good.
This is for the FOOD TRUCK. Pretty lowbrow. Their idea of a vegetarian quesadilla is cheese, stringy nearly-raw onions, and poorly chopped, nearly uncooked bell pepper. Nasty.
Randomly found this place for lunch. The birria was delicious!!! With it being sorta hidden, I assume not many people come. It was empty! Go check it out!
AMAZING. FREAKING AMAZING. GO HERE RIGHT NOW. I had the steak tacos and we also got the chicken quesadilla and they were both absolutely amazing. Do not wait, go now.

Professional clean and delicious tacos. I stop by Amoco to get gas and didn't see any fast food restaurants that interested me and I saw the food truck. Best decision for my lunch. Enjoyed every bit of it.

I would not recommend the tacos. However these were some of the best loaded carne asada Nachos I've had. Just don't be a dummy and order Nachos to go. They must be eaten fresh. If you're a fan of raw ceviche or ahi tuna fish then I'd also recommend the Peruvian ceviche.

We stopped by Trippy Tacos after visiting Brookside Garden and we were blown away by how fresh and delicious everything tasted. We ordered five different tacos along with a side of rice and chicken for our 4yr old twins. Everyone left happy, full, and excited to come back again. Highly recommend checking it out if you are hungry for a legit taco, torta, or burrito.

Love the fresh-made tortillas, that sets them apart. While the al-pastor is good, it should really either be called carne enchilada or they gotta get that pineapple in there. Trippy Tacos, if you really want to elevate yourselves over the typical taco-situation around here, make it your goal to make the best real al pastor! Get a trompo out front, get the fresh pineapple going, combine that with the fresh tortillas you're already doing. Don Perez has their birria and you can't really beat them there, but al pastor? Make it your specialty, I believe in you!
Food truck! Love the lenguas! They can make cheese quesadillas also even if it's not on the menu. The al pastor taco is pretty good also. Have gotten food from the truck twice now.
I was excited but the food was ok. It was dry and tasted reheated. I will not return.
Pretty good tacos, I wish they were closer to me. Tacos are my favorite food, and I would go to this place again and again.
Food is very disappointing. Fries were soggy, tasted frozen covered in nacho cheese, taco meat was really greasy, tortillas were too thick. Way overpriced and kind of gross. Do not recommend.

Worth the stop. Quick and cheap yet tastes amazing. I had the lengua (beef tongue), al pastor, and the steak tacos. Served with onion and cilantro. The meats were juicy and tasty. For under $10 I got 3 tacos. You can't beat that!

I got to try them at Rocklands. Delicious food. My favorite was the mulitos with their chicken. Guacamole was yum and with hearty salty chips. I prefer the el pastor tacos but the steak was really good too. The mild sauce was perfect.
Really good tacos with thick tortillas, juicy meat and fries on the side. Reasonably priced.
Great tacos. Owners are kind and love to support the community. Would go again anytime.

I love this food truck! The food is fantastic. I've had the lengua tacos (several times), and a steak burrito. The lengua is succulent and some of the best I've had. They do thick, fresh, handmade corn tortillas made to order. The burrito is definitely big enough to be your dinner and your lunch the next day. The owner of this truck is super friendly, and just adds to the good experience overall. I recommend this truck to all my friends, and heard good things about the vegetarian option too. Check it out!

Someone owes us some money back! $32 to be exact, this place was not good. The food was soggy, tasteless, and not at all what is shown on any of their social media. Maybe they had a bad cook today or maybe social media has just hyped them, I don't know. What I do know is, I'll never visit here again. I knew I should have went to Taqueria Habanero like I started to. There's no indoor seating, well it's actually a bar with 6 tall stools.
Trippy fries were great! The taco was some of the best I've had in Maryland. Service was really nice and quick too! Overall, just a great place to eat for lunch or dinner.

I had all 4 taco flavors (chicken, beef, lengua, al pastor) which were pretty good. I'm an OCD person which made me look into the cleanliness of the truck and it was pretty good. Maybe they should have put a lime on the side but other than that it was really good. Oh and the tortillas are hand made and good which is a plus.
Super good tacos. They make the tortillas right there. They have a vegan option too. Everything is very tasty.

Food is great. Do not place your pickup order through the website. Apparently they don't monitor that for orders, so they wait until you get there and order again to start preparing the food. And since it's made to order (obviously) it can be awhile.

Great Mexican style tacos! I got a chicken taco and a steak taco, and it was the best taco meat I've had since my visit to Austin. Plus, they make the corn tortillas in the truck and they were great! Looking forward to the next time I have an opportunity to get more.
Friendly staff with delicious simple food! Their house made sauces and tortillas separate them from others! If you're an adventurous eater try the Lengua (tongue) tacos! They're tender and delicious!

The tongue tacos were amazing, the cheese and steak quesadillas were so good and fresh. Really appreciate the fact they make their own tortillas and they were very tasty. Will definitely be going back for more!!! It's worth the try that's for sure you won't be disappointed.
Amazing! Had one of each type of protein and none of it disappoints. But I must say the steak was absolute perfection! I would definitely go here again. Can't wait to try their tortas next!

This is my first time eating Trippy Tacos off the truck at Saints Row Brewery on Taft. Talk about authentic Mexican street tacos. The lengua was amazing! Al pastor awesome! And if you want the sauces - the rusty hot is a great complement - even for someone like me with a low heat tolerance!! Truly great find...

Had the quesadilla al pastor. Huge portion fit for a big guy like me and it was so tasty. Came with a poblano pepper sauce with a smooth smoky flavor. Now that was some awesome sauce. Looking forward to trying the rest of the menu, maybe not all at once.

Fantastic!!! Trippy Tacos provided services during our school's Faculty Week Welcome BBQ and they were a hit. The food was fresh and flavorful (tacos and nachos) and the guacamole and salsa was delicious! Will definitely bring them back for next year's event!!

They came to my building and this was my first time having authentic tacos. So delicious and fresh, even down to the guac. I love how the steak had no fat/marble on it. They used a good cut. The chips and salsa was good and the quesadilla. I wish I had gotten 3 tacos and not 2. Also paying $3 per taco is ok.... but it would be nice if they offered combos. Please come back to laurel soon.
Great Burritos and Tacos! Friendly, fast service. This combined with great music at a local micro brewery made for a perfect evening. You won't want to miss chowing down with Trippy's!
Trippy Taco is delicious. The handmade tortillas are to die for. The homemade hot sauces are tasty. The staff is friendly and fast. I highly recommend trying these guys if you run across them!
